title: "Welcome Jay Joshi!"

author: 
  - name: Thomas Rose
    orcid: 0000-0002-8186-3566
date: "2026-05-01"
description: "Jay Joshi joins the team as software developer"
---

Starting today, [Jay Joshi](../team.qmd#jay-joshi) joins the team and will spearhead the development of the TerraLID web application. 

Jay brings much needed expertise in the design and development of web applications to the TerraLID core team. In addition to developing the app, he will ensure together with the [TerraLID Editors](../team.qmd#regional-editors) that the TerraLID App is user-friendly, fast, and includes all the features needed by the community to work with the data in the TerraLID database. 

Welcome to the team, Jay!
